posts.text: ADHD partners don’t forget people—they forget tasks.
ADHD for minorities means decoding trauma before you even start healing.
If you’re a high achievers with ADHD and the dream in your head is crystal clear but actually getting it out into the world overwhelms you, this space is for you. ❤️
ADHD is learning to play chess in a world built for checkers. Be honest — this one’s you too, right?

You explain your own diagnosis to the doctor who's supposed to be explaining it to you. You walk in with research, symptoms lined up like evidence, because you've learned the hard way that nobody hands you support, you have to build the case yourself. That exhaustion is real and it's not just you, a lot of the system still isn't built for how ADHD actually shows up in adults. One thing that helps, write your three worst examples down before the appointment, specific moments, not vague feelings.
ADHD means makes me build systems for systems and honestly, I’m proud of the chaos.
